recipes.Name: Cloth
recipes.Description: A loosely woven fabric. It's a tad scratchy, but you're sure you can overlook that.

recipes.Name: Rope
recipes.Description: A long cord wound of dried grass. You're not too sure if it could hold your weight, but you could make something new with it.

recipes.Name: Shirt
recipes.Description: You feel oddly proud holding this shirt. You don't tend to sew, but you'res sure anyone with this stunning outfit will feel like the coolest guy around.

recipes.Name: Trousers
recipes.Description: You feel oddly proud holding these trousers. You don't tend to sew, but you'res sure anyone with this stunning outfit will feel like the coolest guy around.

recipes.Name: Basket
recipes.Description: A long cord wound of dried grass. You're not too sure if it could hold your weight, but you could make something new with it.

recipes.Name: Bowl
recipes.Description: A smooth wooden bowl, looks like it would be pretty good to eat soup or noodles out of.

recipes.Name: Maraca
recipes.Description: You could get real groovy with these, although you're not very good at playing them.

recipes.Name: Pebbles
recipes.Description: You're not sure why you thought to smash two rocks together, but they both broke...

recipes.Name: Shard
recipes.Description: You figured you could chip away at this rock and create a sort of sharp tool. Surely you could make something with this.

recipes.Name: Hammer
recipes.Description: A heavy tool, this should endure a few hits. This will be helpful! Careful to not crush your fingers.

recipes.Name: Sand
recipes.Description: You've crushed these rocks as much as you can.

recipes.Name: Axe
recipes.Description: Strong! Not sure you could cut a tree down with this but you could definitely use it to cut logs. Will last a few solid hits.

recipes.Name: Sticks
recipes.Description: It's some sticks. You're not sure why you keep breaking things down but surely something will be useful.

recipes.Name: Thread
recipes.Description: Strong thread, not the neatest but will hold any fabric together.

recipes.Name: Scissors
recipes.Description: Careful, these are sharp. They'll definitely be useful, though. They seem decently sturdy, you could use these a few times.

recipes.Name: Needle
recipes.Description: Surprisingly pointy!

recipes.Name: PottingMix
recipes.Description: A good mix for potting all your plants. It might grow some unexpected additions to your gardem though.

recipes.Name: Mulch
recipes.Description: A good mix for potting all your plants. It might grow some unexpected additions to your gardem though.

recipes.Name: Rags
recipes.Description: It's a shame to cut this fabric up but these will be good for cleaning up messes.

recipes.Name: Ladder
recipes.Description: A simple rope ladder. Stable enough but you wouldn't trust it to last forever.
